patthana16.21:1.1: kusalaṃ cittasahabhuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na kusalo na cittasahabhu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, pañca.
patthana16.21:2.1: akusalaṃ cittasahabhuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na akusalo na cittasahabhū dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. pañca,
patthana16.21:3.1: akusalaṃ cittasahabhuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na akusalo na cittasahabhū dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. tīṇi,
patthana16.21:5.1: kusalaṃ no cittasahabhuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na kusalo na no cittasahabhū dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. pañca,
patthana16.21:6.1: akusalaṃ no cittasahabhuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na akusalo na no cittasahabhū dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. pañca,
patthana16.21:7.1: abyākataṃ no cittasahabhuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na kusalo na no cittasahabhū dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. tīṇi.
